mapper.sql: id, document_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, metadata, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_segment (document_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{embedding}::vector, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), now())

INSERT INTO knowledge_segment (document_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, metadata, created_at) VALUES
(#{s.documentId}, #{s.chunkIndex}, #{s.content}, #{s.embedding}::vector, CAST(#{s.metadata} AS jsonb), now())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_segment WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_segment SET content = #{content}, embedding = #{embedding}::vector WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS id, s.document_id AS documentId, d.name AS documentName, s.content AS content, (1 - (s.embedding <=> #{embedding}::vector)) AS similarity FROM knowledge_segment s LEFT JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = s.document_id ORDER BY s.embedding <=> #{embedding}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
